endorsements.name: Christien Rioux
endorsements.label: Lessons Of Binary Analysis
endorsements.description: Ever wanted to know more about how static binary analysis works? It's complicated. Ever want to know how C++ language elements are automatically transformed? The high-level overview of how machines analyze code for security flaws is just the beginning. In this talk we'll be delving into the gritty details of the modeling process.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2012
